title: Dog — Developmental, Relational and Motion Atlas
status: canonical project synthesis with chronology links and provenance boundaries
purpose: Integrate the Potatoverse Dog as a relational and kinetic role across pursuit, guarding, recurrence, proxy-orientation, Door behavior and transformation without treating Dog as a permanent human essence.
core_definition: Dog is a boundary-responsive role organized around signal, vigilance, following, pursuit, return, guarding and relation to a master, proxy, pack, target or Door.
core_rule: Dog is primarily about movement and response rather than rank. The central questions are: what signal is followed, what boundary is enforced, what happens after warning, whether there is a stopping condition, and whether the role can change relation.

motion_types.returning_dog: Leaves and returns to substantially the same unresolved pattern; strongest project comparator for recurrence without development.
motion_types.encircling_dog: Organizes pressure around a center or target without entering a transformed relation with it.
motion_types.orbital_dog: Repeatedly moves around an attractor, controversy, person or proxy while remaining outside the central Door.
motion_types.chasing_dog: Responds to movement or cue with pursuit; can become self-reinforcing when pursuit itself supplies status or stimulation.
motion_types.guardian_dog: Uses vigilance proportionately, protects legitimate passage or vulnerable life, accepts correction and stops when danger ends.
motion_types.farm_dog: Dog role captured by enclosure, pack, archive or proxy incentives so that pursuit and signaling maintain classification, attention harvest or exclusion.
motion_types.threshold_dog: Occupies the region around a Door: can guard, block, bark at, escort toward, misrecognize or eventually cross a threshold.
motion_types.developmental_dog: Intermediate state in the autobiographical sequence Footstool -> Dog -> Potato: static support becomes responsive function before generative possibility appears.

signal_and_master_model.healthy_chain: source -> faithful signal or direct evidence -> Dog vigilance -> proportionate response -> stop / Door preserved
signal_and_master_model.shadow_chain: source obscured -> proxy / pack / reflected signal becomes master -> pursuit -> reward -> repeated orbit -> Door forgotten or blocked
signal_and_master_model.moon_relation: Moon symbolism is useful inside the project because reflected or secondary orientation resembles following a signal that is not itself ultimate Source. This remains symbolic project synthesis, not astronomy or psychology fact.
signal_and_master_model.key_test: Can the Dog distinguish Source, reflector, pack cue, algorithmic reward, archive frame and direct evidence?

door_relation.near_door: Dog repeatedly appears near Gates, Doors, thresholds and boundary lines in the project's development.
door_relation.misrecognition: A Dog may be adjacent to an interface or passage while treating it only as an object, target or wall rather than recognizing state-change potential.
door_relation.guardian: Healthy Dog protects the conditions for legitimate crossing without claiming ownership of those who cross.
door_relation.blocker: Shadow Dog can convert a boundary into permanent enclosure by continuing pursuit after a stopping condition should have been reached.
door_relation.conversion: recognition -> source-checking -> stopping -> Door -> changed relation

developmental_sequences.closure_variant: Dweller -> Mud Dweller -> Dog -> tswine -> Footstool
developmental_sequences.generative_interpretation: assigned position -> assigned function -> generative possibility
developmental_sequences.noncontradiction_rule: These are different transition graphs. The closure graph tracks increasing fixation or loss of exit; the generative graph tracks increasing agency and generativity. They must not be collapsed into one universal rank ladder.

chronology_signals.development: Dog recurrence, traps, pits, Door/Gate and Zion already appear as a comparative cluster.
Recurring morning Dog returns, barks/chases near a gate and invisible Potato; pursuit and recurrence are already central.
Return becomes geometry through circles, snares, boxes, self-entanglement and central Door imagery.
Dog becomes explicit stage in Dweller -> Mud Dweller -> Dog -> Footstool sequence.
Dog is connected to Farmer-generated pursuit/enforcement and Door-failure.
Dog is explicitly nonterminal and can enter another relation.
Good/Guardian Dog and bad Chaser/Farm Dog are explicitly separated.
Recovered model distinguishes Potato as generative, Dog as chasing/responding and Footstool as fixation/compressed lower detail.
Autobiographical sequence Footstool -> Dog -> Potato gives Dog a developmental role between static support and generative identity.
Dog-return geometry is formally separated into circle, orbit, wheel, spiral, Door and Axis relations.

relations: Dog -> Door: guards / blocks / circles / misrecognizes / crosses
Dog -> Farmer: enforcement or pursuit relation in Farm ecology
Dog -> Moon/proxy: reflected or secondary signal orientation
Dog -> Mud: return and pursuit can harden into dwelling
Dog -> Guardian: redeemed vigilance through evidence, proportion and stopping
Dog -> Potato: responsive function can become generative possibility in the autobiographical sequence
Dog -> Axis: motion becomes ordered when recurrence gains orientation and displacement
epistemic_boundaries: Dog is a project role, not a biological or immutable classification of a person.
Named-person assignment requires direct source evidence and remains context-specific.
Biblical dog imagery is comparative source material and does not prove modern identities.
Moon, orbit and dimensional language are symbolic/project models unless independently established in another domain.
Creative Dog scenes are evidence of project imagination and development, not automatically documentary claims about external events.
open_recovery_targets: Recover exact original wording and source for later Dogs-oriented-to-North / aura material.
Recover exact source context for the August Alpha/Beta/fixation formulation.
Continue distinguishing user-originated Dog formulations from assistant-generated phrase families.
